div.p: The Broker: , represented by (), , Emirates ID (the "Broker").

The Company appoints the Broker, on a non-exclusive basis, to introduce buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants for the Company's properties and projects, in accordance with the laws and regulations of the United Arab Emirates and of the emirate in which the property is located.

The Broker declares that it holds, and will keep valid throughout this agreement, a trade licence covering real estate brokerage and the registration or card required by the competent real estate regulator, and that it will notify the Company immediately of any suspension, expiry or cancellation.

Commission is earned only on transactions introduced by the Broker that are concluded and paid for in accordance with the Company's commission schedule in force on the date of the transaction, and is payable only after the Company has received the corresponding customer payment. Commission is paid to the bank account declared by the Broker. Value added tax is applied where applicable.

The Broker will deal honestly and transparently with all parties, will not make misleading statements, will not collect payments from customers on behalf of the Company unless authorised in writing, and will advertise properties only with the permits required by the regulator.

The Broker confirms compliance with the UAE anti-money-laundering, counter-terrorist financing and sanctions laws applicable to real estate brokers, including registration on the goAML platform and reporting of suspicious transactions, and will cooperate with the Company's due-diligence requests.
Each party keeps confidential the information it receives and processes personal data only for the purposes of this agreement and in accordance with the applicable UAE data protection law.

This agreement starts on signature and continues until terminated by either party with thirty (30) days' written notice, or immediately by the Company if the Broker breaches this agreement or loses its licence or registration.
This agreement is governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates as applied in the emirate of , and the competent courts of that emirate have jurisdiction.
